Only `long-number` is listed, not `aggregate-base64-fragments` as on the apps/mobile entry -- this file tripped exactly three long-number findings and nothing else, and an allowlist should exempt what the file actually does rather than what a file of its kind might do.

Pinned by exact digest rather than exempted by filename, for the reason spelled out on the apps/mobile entry: a name-based exemption is the smuggling route this guard's own tests reject.

It arrives with the commit that removed 23 absolute home-directory paths from 17 QA scripts. Those scripts imported puppeteer-core and playwright-core by absolute path into one developer's node_modules, so nothing declared them and nothing could install them elsewhere; tests/qa/package.json now does, and this lock file is what makes `npm ci` there reproduce the same tree. Five direct dependencies, pinned to the versions the sibling harnesses rd-qa-02/ and rd-qa-06/ already use.
